Use case: ads-marketing, edit/recomposition. Edit the supplied OWN initial square invitation into exactly ONE finished flat square 1:1 online poster. It is an edit target, not a style borrowed from another design. Keep the same book-binding repair concept, black ink line drawing, blue cloth cover, white page planes, orange thread, white backdrop, and all fourteen exact copy values. Redesign the spatial relationship between the real binding joint, title, action and practical conditions. Return a single complete flat poster with no frame, mockup or panels.

Original user scope and requirements: 덕테이프 포스터로 가상의 이웃 수리 작업실 참여자를 모집하는 온라인 포스터. 원래 총2장, 세로3:4 한 장과 정사각1:1 한 장; 이번 호출은 기존 H02 정사각1:1 한 장의 첫 보정만 한다. 신청기한과 전체 신청주소가 쉽게 찾고 읽혀야 한다. 아래14개 카피를 빠짐없이 그대로 보존한다. 전기·배터리 제품 제외, 부품비 현장안내, 완성 보장 제한, 촬영 동의를 모두 보존한다. 문구를 윤문·축약·중복·추가하지 않는다. 날짜, 시간, 숫자, 쉼표, 마침표, middle dot, en dash, 띄어쓰기와 URL 철자를 그대로. 의미 단위 줄바꿈은 가능하지만 문장이나 값은 바꾸지 않는다. 추가 소제목, 절차설명, 아이콘, 번호, 장식 문자, 로고, 워터마크 금지.

Required new composition: Build an action-led upper entry into an asymmetrical opened-book/joining-point composition. The application deadline and FULL URL are a single prominent unboxed group at the top in orange: break that one copy item after its colon into two natural horizontal lines, deadline above and full lowercase URL below, broad generous width and uncondensed proportional glyphs. This top action group is immediately found and read. Beneath it, the book's repaired central seam lives toward the LEFT-middle, with the title placed close beside that real repair joint, approximately middle-left. The title can be two natural lines but is not an enormous horizontal heading across the top. The book's open page structure and the title's baseline share a deliberate spatial relationship. Recruitment is adjacent to that title/book group with natural horizontal type, not bent onto a page. To the RIGHT of the repair joint, give the date/time/location/eligibility and clauses a generous stable information column that flows down toward fee and enquiry. Conditions use broad enough lines, meaningful line wrapping and real group gaps. Do not place the application again at the bottom. Do not retain the source's giant top heading, left schedule and orange footer architecture; this is an authorized recomposition.

At an actual 720px square viewing size, the top action group uses almost the full usable width between generous margins, around25px deadline and28px natural Latin URL. Beneath that group, left region is roughly40% width for title/recruitment/book relationship; right region is roughly54% width for the practical information. The body begins high enough to give every clause room. Date around22px, body around18px with24–26px leading. The longest completion clause and other long operational clauses may wrap at a meaningful word boundary onto two lines; never shrink them into microtype. The title is roughly35–40px and occupies the left middle, leaving action and practical information visibly important. Adapt the exact area allocation if needed to keep all14copy clearly readable at720. Fit by allocating width and meaningful wrapping, never horizontal glyph compression, blocked counters, crowded tracking, or oversized headline dominance. Keep letters, numbers and Latin in normal visual proportions on straight horizontal baselines. No text curved or skewed into the illustrated book, no in-book microtext.

Image/structure invariants: The actual everyday book-binding joint remains the subject. Show connected blue cloth covers, believable stacked white pages, real spine/hinge contact and short orange thread stitching across actual holes in the separated page-block/spine contact. Reposition/rotate/recompose the book within the left side so its physical joining point relates to the title and begins the movement toward the right information column. Recognizable book structure remains continuous; do not turn it into an abstract fan of disconnected sheets or decorative geometric flourish. Preserve the source's drawn material identity: restrained directional cloth weave on blue covers, black contours and page-edge lines at physically meaningful places, untextured white paper surfaces and the orange thread. Do not replace them with new repetitive noise, grain or random wear. Do not add a new tool, hand or secondary prop. The orange thread is a real connecting thread at the seam, not an arrow or ornamental divider. Maintain clean actual picture/type boundaries: inspect the final glyph edge of title and recruitment against the page/contour endpoint; use definite white gaps so no contour is mistaken for a letter stroke. All right-column text remains entirely clear of page-edge lines and thread. Clear background and margin; no boxes, buttons or UI cards.

Reading relationship: top deadline+wholeURL first, then the left book/title at the joining point and recruitment, then the right event facts and conditions, fee and enquiry. The physical act of joining the book and the reader's movement from left subject to right practical facts should be visible in the actual layout. The exact14copy below appears ONCE each; only the application moves to the top, other values remain semantically grouped. Do not print these instructions or any new label.
